$comment: Component inventory — generated by tooling/scripts/build-manifest.mjs. Do not hand-edit: run `pnpm manifest` (or `--check` to verify). Paths, component list and props are derived from the source files.

stack.styling: Tailwind CSS v4 (@tailwindcss/vite, no preflight) bridged via @theme inline onto generated M3 role tokens; scoped token-driven CSS for pseudo-element machinery
stack.monorepo: pnpm workspaces: apps/web + packages/{design-system,ui,config}. tooling/scripts is a plain directory of Node scripts, not a workspace package.
stack.clientJs: minimal, vanilla, transform/opacity only; JS-driven reveal orchestration + ambient hero wave (no reduced-motion suppression, v0.7.0 policy)

backgroundSystem.name: exact-reference hero dots (hero-only rule)

canvas.carrier: html (opaque #ECECEC light / #1E1E1E dark — exact theretriever.app body backgrounds)
canvas.note: opaque body background would hide the z-index:0 hero wave (known bug class; verify-design-contract.mjs guards)

application.scope: hero ONLY — no other dotted surface allowed
application.pattern: animated canvas dot wave painted by public/wave.js (byte-exact reference port; v0.7.0: upstream reduced-motion still-frame branch patched out per owner motion policy — pristine copy + provenance in docs/reference-assets/)
application.attributes: data-speed 0.5, data-alpha 1.6, data-size 1.6, 48x26 grid (dotwave token group, injected from design-tokens.json at build time)
application.mask: dual linear-gradient mask composited with intersect (--dotwave-mask-x/y)
application.source: live headless-Chrome forensics of theretriever.app hero (2026-10-22, tool-results/ref-forensics/)

nonDotVisualLanguage: About states: verified decay-1/2/3.svg dot-matrix illustrations as content figures (byte-exact reuse, provenance md5s)
Experience zones: solid ink fill + tertiary hatch + void
brand mark: unit box in frame (rect only, zero circles)
guards: hero canvas: pointer-events none, IntersectionObserver-gated paint, DPR-aware
hero is the ONLY dotted surface (contract D3: no radial-gradient circles, no extra canvas.wave)

components.name: Layout
responsibilities: inline boot script that sets the html.js gate (sha256-pinned by the CSP)
loads the external reveal observer (public/reveal.js) and the hero wave (public/wave.js)
a11y: no reduced-motion branch (v0.7.0 motion policy: motion runs for everyone)

components.name: ContactScene
features: exclusive <details name=faq> accordion, plus→minus icon (transform only)

components.name: CredentialsScene
features: two credential groups; featured group = m3-card--filled

components.name: Heading
components.notes: M3 headline-large; explicit line blocks for viewport-stable rhythm

components.name: Hero
features: hero carries the ONLY dotted surface — an animated <canvas class="wave"> painted by public/wave.js
stage panel = flat reference card (container-lowest + outline-variant hairline + 12px radius), no sonar
app window with pulse grid (in-window UI, dark chrome)

components.name: PrinciplesBlock
components.notes: 'How I work' — 4 principle bullets; inline deep links

components.name: ProjectsScene
features: project cards with impact bar art (aria-hidden)

components.name: Scene
components.notes: hairline-divided section wrapper; transparent BG so the shared canvas shows through

components.name: AppWindow
components.notes: inverse-surface chrome, traffic dots, level-2 elevation (--md-elevation-level2).

components.name: Button
components.notes: M3 common button — Tailwind-native, token-bridged. Renders an <a> (no <button>), so it cannot be used for in-page actions.

components.name: Card
components.notes: M3 card shell; consumer supplies the heading and body semantics.

components.name: Chip
components.notes: Renders an <a> when href is given, otherwise a <span>.

components.name: SceneShell
components.notes: Tailwind-native scene wrapper — the twin of the app-level Scene.astro.

components.name: SectionHeading
components.notes: <h2> with explicit line blocks — the Tailwind-native twin of the app-level Heading.astro.

buttons: @pba/ui Button (Tailwind-native; used by Hero and SkillsScene)

contentModel.schema: exported readonly interfaces (single source of copy)
contentModel.mustEditMarkers: none since v0.3.0 — every value sourced from the owner's real CV + previous portfolio; v0.4.0 enriched with verifiable specifics (thesis L18/ANOVA, crusher QFD, SSC); do not invent facts

clientJs.public/reveal.js: 1413 bytes — IntersectionObserver reveal; adds html.no-observe when IntersectionObserver is missing

qa.cspRender: tooling/scripts/verify-csp-render.mjs (serves dist with the real _headers; asserts no console errors + every [data-reveal] revealed)
